reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jackie Simon
reviewSamples.text: I saw a Sign for Drip Pressure Cleaning And decided to have them do my driveway and my pavers. G was very thorough very professional and did a great job! And the price was very reasonable. I’m very very happy with his work. I’ll be using him in the future as well. Great decision to hire him.
